entries.d15e00337d665759: These are high-function parts and equipment, such as joints, tubes, pumps and valves made of high-performance resin, sold under the product name for fluororesin products. entries.e5202a3f20bdc5c6: In April 2026, the company formulated the medium-term management plan “One2030,” whose final fiscal year is 2030. In the Electronic Equipment-Related Business, the company will make maximum use of its Fukuchiyama No. 2 Plant to expand production volume and improve productivity of semiconductor-related products, will start manufacturing semiconductor-related products at its Chuzhou plant in China, and will strengthen development of the Chinese market through sales bases in Shanghai and Beijing. In the Industrial Equipment-Related Business, the company will push to expand its global share of mechanical seals (rotary joints) for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and seek differentiation by developing and supplying high-performance seal products for clean energy markets such as hydrogen, ammonia and SAF, and will collaborate with Tanken Seal Seiko Co., Ltd. in technology, production and sales. The numerical targets of the plan are not transcribed.
